QuestInfo.name: Wolf Mount
QuestInfo.0: It looks like there are a couple of people who know how to handle Wolf Pups. You should head over to #b#m211000000##k and talk to #b#p2020007##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2020007# taught you about the Wolf Mount, which will make you swift as the wind! But you'll need to get some items for #p2020007# if you want to ride it. \r\n\r\n#i4000048# #t4000048# #b#c4000048# / 50#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2020007# taught you how to ride a flipping WOLF! Take #t1902016# out and race like the wind!

0.0: Whoa, is that a wolf? I haven't seen anyone carry a wolf in ages! But why aren't you using it as a #bMount#k? From your bewildered expression, you probably don't know what I'm talking about...
0.1: Well, it's just as it sounds. You ride on the wolf's back and it allows you to move lightning fast. Oh boy, did I have some glorious days of riding #o5130104#s and #o5140000#s in the past!
0.2: Interested in riding one yourself? If so, then allow me, #p2020007#, to help you.
0.3: Just because you want to ride your wolf as a Mount doesn't mean you can ride it just like that. Before anything, you must find a #b#t1912011##k so you won't hurt your wolf. I'll make the saddle for you if you bring me the materials to make it.
0.4: The key material for the #t1912011# is #b#t4000048##k. I think about #b50#k should do it. When you bring me the materials, I'll give you the Monster Mount skill along with the #t1912011#. Now, hurry.

1.0: Did you collect all the #t4000048#s? Wow, that was quick! You must really want to turn your wolf into a Mount! Now give me a minute to make this.

yes.0: Now you can be like me, a wolf rider! Your friends are going to be so jealous, I promise.

item.0: Did you get me #b50 #t4000048#s#k yet? I need enough leather to make a #t1912011#...
